design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.detail: Moises and LALAL agreeing more with each other than with Demucs is evidence of shared BEHAVIOUR, not shared correctness. Both are plausibly HTDemucs/band-split derivatives trained on similar data, so they may share a bias. Q1 consensus is only informative if the separators are architecturally independent, and that cannot be verified from the outputs.
design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.mitigation: report consensus as agreement, never as accuracy, unless a ground-truth leg exists

design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.trap: stem taxonomies are not comparable as given
design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.detail: Demucs gives 4 stems, Moises and LALAL give more. Summing 'pitched stems' means different things per separator.
design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.mitigation: define the pitched reconstruction as FULL RECONSTRUCTION MINUS the drum/percussion stems. That is comparable across taxonomies at the level that matters and does not manufacture instrument identity from `other`.

design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.trap: resampling can masquerade as harmonic difference
design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.detail: separators output at their own sample rates; the analysis runs at 16 kHz. Different resamplers or different source rates could produce chroma differences that have nothing to do with separation quality.
design_traps_recorded_for_when_J3H_RUNS.mitigation: record every file's native sample rate and channel count, and use one identical resampling path for all conditions

programme_impact.J3F_untouched: TIMBRE_FRONTEND_DOMINANT stands. J3H was never a test of J3F: J3F used BabySlakh's actual rendered stems, which are better than any separator can produce.
programme_impact.J3G_unaffected: J3G_EXISTING_STFT_HARMONIC_RECOVERY remains the recommended path and does not wait on J3H. J3F showed the frontend deserves work even with perfect synthetic stems.
programme_impact.what_J3H_would_still_add: whether high-quality separation changes the economics on REAL audio - a different question, still open, and worth answering once assets exist.
